name: Tropic croton
desc: Tropic croton (Croton glandulosus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Croton glandulosus is a species of plant in the family Euphorbiaceae that has many common names such as vente conmigo, tooth-leaved croton, tropic croton and sand croton.
